title: Design: a matrix row's menu and the General Matrix's grayed Delete
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open matrix A's three-dot menu.
  3. Press Esc.
  4. Open the General Matrix's three-dot menu.
  5. Point at Delete.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • A small menu opens below the button with Duplicate, then Delete in red, as in picture 6.11.

Step 3:

  • The menu closes.

Step 4:

  • The menu lists Duplicate and a grayed Delete.

Step 5:

  • A dark tooltip reads "The General Matrix can't be deleted. You can edit it."
  • It shows just below Delete, as in picture 6.12.
